text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — platform is adding a route policy header for quota routing. Proposed headers: x-rw-route-policy and x-rw-quota-hint. Plan is to ship behind a feature flag next week. Please chime in if SDKs need a different surface.
Samir Patel: Can we keep compatibility with the old x-route header? Some customers' proxies still rely on it.
Maria Chen: We plan to accept x-route at the edge (shim) but want SDKs to start emitting the new header. Need migration guidance for Python/TS/Go.
JLee (eng-platform): Console note — dashboards group by route id. If header semantics change we risk splitting metrics. Control plane needs a stable mapping table.
Ava (devex): UX question: how will users configure this in client libs? client config key, env var, or per-request? I vote client.config.routePolicy + per-request override.
Tim O'Neil: Go SDK has the header enums in proto; changing defaults is a breaking change. Can we add graceful fallback and a runtime feature flag?
Samir Patel: Telemetry concern: some teams consider route names sensitive. We should default to sending opaque route ids and make verbose names opt-in.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Proposal: default = opaque_route_id; add route_name_opt_in flag in clients; sampling for route_names telemetry behind telemetry.opt_in.
Ava (devex): I'll draft migration doc and code snippets for python/ts. Suggest a one-month deprecation window before hard rejection of x-route.
Samir Patel: Also suggest an integration test for quota dashboards to ensure grouping remains stable when both headers present.
Tim O'Neil: I'll add a Go shim to map legacy enum -> new header at runtime, and feature flag to flip. ETA: Tue.
Maria Chen: Quick code examples for the docs:
```python
# python
client = Redwood(api_key='***', route_policy='payments_high', route_name_opt_in=False)
# sends header: x-rw-route-policy: payments_high
```
```ts
// typescript
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: '***', routePolicy: 'payments_high', routeNameOptIn: false});
// header: x-rw-route-policy
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag created: rollout/route-policy-sdk (targets: beta orgs). :white_check_mark:
Ava (devex): Action items:
- @JLee: confirm control-plane mapping table + dashboard grouping by EOD
- @Tim O'Neil: add Go shim + tests
- @Ava (devex): publish migration doc and snippets + announcement
- @Samir Patel: run quota-dashboard regression and telemetry privacy check
Maria Chen: Thanks team — we'll circle back after JLee confirms mapping. :eyes:
